bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/tumblr-bridge-live-20261114"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "2ab0cea0b720e5d7c8e3cd231b8018e2362419f1"
test -f "$HOME/.config/tgtumbler/bridge/owner-token"
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:tumblr-bridge-candidate >/dev/null
docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}' | grep -qx true
if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if ss -ltn | grep -Eq '127[.]0[.]0[.]1:8876[[:space:]]'; then
    echo 'BRIDGE_PORT_ALREADY_USED' >&2
    exit 32
  fi
fi
docker compose -f "$WT/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -p deploy config -q
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-tumblr-bridge-20261114
active=0
rollback(){
  if [ "$active" != 1 ]; then
    docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-tumblr-bridge-20261114 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || true
    docker compose -f "$WT/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs || true
  fi
}
trap rollback EXIT
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:tumblr-bridge-candidate gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
docker compose -f "$WT/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
for n in $(seq 1 22); do
  if python3 -B - <<'PY'
from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError
try:
    with urlopen(Request("http://127.0.0.1:8876/internal/tumblr",data=b'{}',headers={"Authorization":"Bearer wrong"},method="POST"),timeout=3):
        raise SystemExit(1)
except HTTPError as exc:
    if exc.code==401:raise SystemExit(0)
except Exception:
    pass
raise SystemExit(1)
PY
  then
    test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = "true"
    active=1
    break
  fi
  sleep 3
done
test "$active" = 1
trap - EXIT
printf 'BOT_BRIDGE_RUNNING=YES\n'
